policy: Aliases are an explicit, audited allow-list. ANY name not in official_achievements.json AND not a key here is an ERROR (unknown_target_policy=error). No fuzzy / case / substring matching. Each alias records WHY it exists and resolves to exactly one canonical name (hence one canonical_id).
match_rule: exact, case-sensitive on the alias key

aliases.reason: Upstream craftax enum member is misspelled 'solider' and is kept verbatim as the canonical name. The correctly-spelled 'soldier' is accepted ONLY via this explicit alias so a well-intentioned correct spelling does not become a silent unknown-target error or, worse, a silent drop.
